address: Contrada Passo di Gurra SP 79 km 91, Menfi, 92013, Italy
bio: A luxurious guesthouse belonging to the famous Sicilian winery Planeta and surrounded by beautiful vineyards is the setting for this restaurant serving top-quality Sicilian cuisine. Home-grown ingredients make an appearance in some dishes, while the extensive wine list obviously features a good selection of Planeta’s own labels....
